definitions.explanation: The period of life roughly between the 40s and 60s. Used as a loanword from English, particularly in lifestyle, health, and marketing contexts to refer to this demographic group or life stage.

examples.japanese: ミドルエイジ{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Magazines aimed at the middle-aged are increasing.

examples.japanese: ミドルエイジ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}→健康管理：21662_kenkoukanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you reach middle age, health management becomes important.

examples.japanese: ミドルエイジ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ターゲット→ターゲット：11036_taagetto⟧にした⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: A new fashion brand targeting middle-aged men is generating buzz.

notes:
English loanword from "middle age." In Japanese, this term has a somewhat trendier, more modern feel than the native ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧, and is often used in marketing, media, and lifestyle contexts. It can sound softer or more positive than ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧, which some people find less flattering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ミドルエイジ{向|む}け: aimed at middle-aged people
- ミドルエイジ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧: the middle-age generation
- ミドルエイジ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧: midlife crisis
- ミドルエイジ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧/⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: middle-aged men/women

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧: middle age — the standard Japanese term; can carry a slightly negative or plain nuance
- ⟦{壮年|そうねん}→壮年：19755_sounen⟧: prime of life — more formal, often implies vigor and capability
- ⟦シニア→シニア：08830_shinia⟧: senior — the next life stage, generally 60s and above
